title: Design: Typing in Bill Invoices To narrows the list, this customer stays first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a customer named with a short unique part you can type (for example A & J Truck & Trailer Repair).
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-04-after-searching.png, bt-p1-05-after-picked.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Customer.
  2. Type a new customer name in Name.
  3. Click the Bill Invoices To field.
  4. Type the unique part of the other customer's name (for example A & J).
  5. Click that customer in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • The name shows in Name.

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • Only two rows remain: the "(this customer)" row first, then the matching customer.

Step 5:

  • The list closes and Bill Invoices To shows the picked customer's full name; nothing is saved until Save.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer), story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S2-R4: “In New Customer, the first option reads "[name typed so far] (this customer)", or "New customer (this customer)" before a name is typed.”
  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”
  • S2-R5: “The pick saves together with the window's Save; if any part fails, nothing is saved and no customer is created.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
